title: Rav Sama son of Rav Mesharshiya
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Chullin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.17b.10): Ravina said to Rav Ashi, “Rav Sama son of Rav Mesharshiya told us, in your name, what you had said to him in Rava’s name,” etc.[^1]

notes.text: Ravina addresses Rav Ashi and reports what Rav Sama heard from him in Rava’s name, as [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2811&lang=en) also records. In the continuation, one version has Rav Ashi qualify the inspection requirements. The other has him deny attributing the ruling to Rava.
